title: Control plane: audit export config CRUD endpoints + validation (feature-flagged)
author: Benji Okafor
description: Implements the first-cut control-plane API surface for SIEM-ready audit export config management, gated behind the `siem_audit_export_beta` feature flag. This PR adds CRUD endpoints for export configurations (S3 / Splunk HEC / Datadog Logs), request validation (destination-specific, filter schema, and backfill window constraints), and an audit trail for config changes (create/update/disable/delete + credential rotation reference updates). The API is intended to be consumed by Console (settings page) and by the exporter service config sync. Notes: filtering evaluation stays in the exporter for now, but we validate filter shape + safe defaults here to prevent pathological configs. RBAC integration is stubbed to existing admin checks in this PR; fine-grained permissions land in follow-up (ENG-5173 / PR-28792). Endpoints: `GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/audit-exports/configs` (list), `POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/audit-exports/configs` (create), `GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/audit-exports/configs/{config_id}` (get), `PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/audit-exports/configs/{config_id}` (update/disable), `DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/audit-exports/configs/{config_id}` (delete soft-delete). Includes `POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/audit-exports/configs/{config_id}:test` for destination connectivity smoke checks (no event payloads; uses destination adapter preflight in a controlled sandbox). Storage: new `audit_export_configs` table + migrations; config payload stored as typed columns + JSONB for destination settings with strict schema. Audit events: emits `audit.export_config.*` actions with stable `event_id`, actor, workspace, config_id, destination_type, and minimal redacted settings (no secrets). Feature flag behavior: when disabled, endpoints return 404 to avoid API surface discovery; when enabled but tenant not allowlisted (handled in follow-up), behavior is controlled by the existing enterprise beta gate (temporary). Backfill semantics: create supports an optional `backfill_start` up to 7 days in the past; update allows moving forward only (no widening).
